description: This file is part of the Moment.js library, specifically responsible for managing locale data and configuration, including importing and exporting locale-related functions and data lists.

methods.name: deprecate
methods.description: Utility function for deprecating old methods such as 'moment.lang' and 'moment.langData'.

calls: deprecate('moment.lang is deprecated. Use moment.locale instead.', getSetGlobalLocale)
